messages:
emma.p: Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace is asking for our SOC 2 Type II report, a high-level pen-test summary (redacted), and a small artifact bundle (network diagram, encryption proof, SSO config screenshots) by EOD Friday. They want upload links and a contact for follow-ups.

daniel.k: Do we have a recent SOC2 PDF we can share?

sara_l: Yes — SOC2.pdf is in GDrive under Security/Compliance/2025. It has org-level redactions. We need sec approval before sending. :lock:

nora_sec: Confirmed. SOC2 doc is good to share with Marketplace once we strip the vendor-only appendix. I'll do the redaction.

mike_ops: For the pen test, we have a high-level summary (PenTest-2024-summary.txt) — but the full report is under NDA with the testing firm. We can provide an executive summary + remediation status.

emma.p: Marketplace specifically called out: "proof of encryption at rest, KMS key rotation policy, SSO SAML metadata, and a network diagram showing VPC placement (no internal IPs exposed)."

legal-ops: We'll need to confirm there's no restricted data in the pen-test artifact. Also check the marketplace upload T&Cs re: retention. Tagging @partners-bot to create a follow-up ticket.

partners-bot: Ticket PKG-891 created: Marketplace artifact handoff. Assignees: @nora_sec, @mike_ops. Due: 2025-03-14 EOD. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PKG-891

daniel.k: Who will actually upload to the Marketplace portal? I can if someone grants me portal access.

emma.p: I'll coordinate portal access with Cloud Partnerships. Ideally Security uploads SOC2 and encryption artifact, Ops uploads network diagram and SSO screenshots. I'll be the contact for Marketplace.

nora_sec: Upload checklist I propose:
- SOC2 Type II (redacted)
- Pen-test executive summary (redacted)
- Network diagram (PNG, labeled)
- KMS policy doc (PDF) + key rotation screenshot
- SSO SAML metadata & SSO config screenshots (okta)
- Statement of data handling (one-paragraph)

sara_l: I'll export the SSO screenshots and confirm Okta metadata file.

mike_ops: Network diagram draft in /shared/diagrams/marketplace-vpc-v2.png. It already masks internal IPs. I'll add a short legend for edge services.

emma.p: Marketplace asked if we support GovCloud and if artifact URLs need region-specific evidence. Answer: we have customers in GovCloud but the standard artifact bundle is global; callout GovCloud support in the statement of data handling.

legal-ops: For the one-paragraph data handling statement, please include our data residency commitment and contact for DSRs. I can draft a short blurb.

nora_sec: Regarding encryption proof: send a screenshot of KMS key rotation settings + a snippet of our KMS policy (no secrets). I will redact ARNs that reveal account numbers.

partners-bot: Reminder: PKG-891 checklist update requested in 24h.

daniel.k: If I need portal access, who is the Cloud Partnerships contact?

emma.p: @maria.partners is out today — use cloud-partnerships@redwood.com; request should contain the ticket link.

mike_ops: One more ask from Marketplace — they want confirmation that we accept vulnerability scan results from third-party integrators. We do, but need to include our process doc link. I'll attach the PROD vuln process (redacted).

sara_l: ETA — I'll have SSO artifacts by tomorrow noon.

nora_sec: I'll finish SOC redaction by tomorrow 5pm and add redaction notes in the ticket.

emma.p: Great. Action summary: @nora_sec redact + upload SOC2; @mike_ops upload network + vuln process; @sara_l SSO exports; @legal-ops draft data statement; I'll package and either upload or hand to Cloud Partnerships for portal ingest.

legal-ops: Draft ready, pushing to PKG-891 comments now.

emma.p: Thanks all — aim to keep the public artifact bundle <= 10 files. If anything sensitive remains, escalate to me and Nora. :thumbsup:

partners-bot: PKG-891 status: In progress (4/6 artifacts attached).
